name: TC-LR-04: Email / Mobile no accepts a 10-digit mobile
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Login/LoginRegister.cy.js#Login - LoginRegister [en] TC-LR-04: Email / Mobile no accepts a 10-digit mobile
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-LR-04
**Title:** Email / Mobile no accepts a 10-digit mobile
**Language:** en

**Description:**
On LOGIN, type a 10-digit mobile into Email / Mobile no. Completing login is OTP-gated and is not driven here (no test OTP is configured; a live Login click with an unregistered mobile did not show GET OTP or fire a login API).

**Expected Result:**
The field keeps the 10-digit mobile the user typed.

**Steps:**
1. Open /login
2. Enter a 10-digit mobile number
3. Verify Email / Mobile no still shows that number
